changelog: `src/lib/ai/fewShotGrounding.ts` (562 lines) splits three ways: the 374-line curated example corpus and its `FewShotExample` type move to `examples.ts`, the BM25 ranking (stop-words, tokenizer, scoring) to `bm25.ts`, and `index.ts` keeps the formatter and selector with the same public API. Import paths did not change, so no caller was edited and the retrieval pins still pass. Previous release: the accuracy benchmark split into fixtures.ts, verifierCases.ts and index.ts.
